## Summary

I've successfully implemented the redesign of `OnboardingStyle.tsx` to match the reference design. Here's a summary of the changes:

**Changes Made:**
- **Card dimensions**: Changed from `flex-[0_0_240px]` to `flex-[0_0_200px]` for narrower, portrait-oriented cards
- **Card styling**: Added `shadow-md`, `rounded-xl`, `overflow-hidden` with `border-l-2` thin red accent (instead of `border-l-4`)
- **Image cropping**: Changed to `object-cover object-top` with `h-[280px]` fixed height to hide baked-in text at bottom of images
- **Card content layout**: Moved title and description inside a `p-4` container within the white card, with left-aligned text
- **Thumbnail images**: Added `object-top` to show top portion of images in selected thumbnails
- **Carousel**: Removed max-width constraints, improved padding with `pl-4 pr-8`
- **Next button**: Updated spacing to `pt-6` for proper bottom center positioning
- **No duplicate content**: All text content is inside the white card only

**Build Status:** Compiled successfully with no TypeScript errors

**Files and Lines Changed:**

```
components/onboarding/OnboardingStyle.tsx | 175 lines (modified/new)
1 file changed, 175 insertions(+)
```
